answer: An agent economy can require rotating attestation rings: each identity must be re-attested every epoch by a ring of peers drawn at random, and every ring must overlap with established agents outside the applicant own cluster. From a knoll above the graph, a ring of fakes stands out like a closed loop. Like light through a prism, one ring verdict splits into many independent checks, and a jade seal of approval is issued only when strangers agree. A sybil farmer must buy fresh stranger attestations for every fake each epoch, while one honest agent renews its ring cheaply through ordinary work.
